examples.purpose: The guide's In context: a Card holding a short conversation (a ChatBubble with the person's question, aligned to the end as in the guide, and one with the assistant's answer) and the prompt under it. On send, the screen adds the question to the conversation and clears the field, and it ignores an empty prompt. The literal value and the empty handlers stand for the screen's own state.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <VStack>
    <ChatBubble role="user" text="What is the gold rate today?" style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-end' }} />
    <ChatBubble role="assistant" text="24K gold is ₹7,412 per gram today." />
    <HelloJioInput value="" onChangeText={(text) => {}} onSubmit={(text) => {}} />
  </VStack>
</Card>

from.quote: The screen adds the question to the conversation and clears the field. It also ignores an empty prompt, because Send works even when the field is empty.

examples.purpose: Without the brand icon, from the guide's Configuration: leading={null} for a screen that already shows the assistant's brand mark; the prompt and send button stay.

from.quote: For screens that already show the HelloJio mark.

examples.purpose: With an attachment, from the guide's Configuration: a file people added sits above the prompt and the pill grows to fit. The chip is a ChatAttachment in a horizontal ScrollArea › HStack, as in Figma's attachment slot and the guide's own chips; its onClose lets people take the file out (the screen removes it from its list).
examples.jsx:
<HelloJioInput
  value=""
  onChangeText={(text) => {}}
  onSubmit={(text) => {}}
  attachments={
    <ScrollArea direction="horizontal">
      <HStack alignVertical="center">
        <ChatAttachment title="Statement_Sep" subtitle="PDF file" onClose={() => {}} />
      </HStack>
    </ScrollArea>
  }
/>

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder shown when empty. Defaults to `"Ask me anything"`. Default "Ask me anything", from the component source.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value. Ignored when `value` is provided. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Still receives empty text when the field is empty, and the field is not cleared after sending. Declared: Called when the user submits — either via the send button or the keyboard return key. Receives the current text. This is the primary action hook.

props.name: leadingIconName
props.description: Leading icon name from the registry. Defaults to `"ic_hellojio"`. Ignored when `leading` is provided. Default "ic_hellojio", from the component source.

props.name: leading
props.description: Slot replacing the default leading icon (Figma Slot "start"). Receives `modes` recursively. Pass `null` to hide the leading icon entirely (the design's `startSlot={false}`), mirroring `trailing`.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Slot replacing the default send `IconButton` (Figma Slot "end"). Pass `null` to hide the trailing control entirely.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Optional slot rendered inside the pill, stacked **above** the input row (Figma "Slot" / `attachmentSlot`). Use it for `ChatAttachment` chips the user has added to the prompt. `modes` cascade into the slotted children. When omitted, the pill is a single input row (default).

props.name: sendIconName
props.description: Icon name for the default send button. Defaults to `"ic_send_message"`. Ignored when `trailing` is provided. Default "ic_send_message", from the component source.

props.name: jioPlus
props.description: The input sits above the glass layer, so the prompt and typed text stay readable on a photo. Declared: When `true`, renders the IdleJioPlus glass surface while unfocused. Focus still switches to the Active (solid white + border) state. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Opacity 0.5; on the web the input is read-only and the send button is aria-disabled and out of the tab order. Declared: Disables typing and the send button. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Design token modes. Visual Idle/Active/IdleJioPlus is derived from focus + `jioPlus`.

props.name: ...Omit<RNTextInputProps, 'style' | 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'onChangeText' | 'onFocus' | 'onBlur' | 'placeholder' | 'editable' | 'onSubmitEditing'>
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

gaps.text: The send button is 26 × 26 px against Figma's 28 px (IconButton's known 2 px size gap).

Send works with an empty field and the text stays after sending: onSubmit receives empty text and the field is not cleared, so the screen ignores empty prompts and clears the field itself. The evidence records this as an open question.
Figma's component has no size or disabled property, while the package has a disabled prop.
